title: Affidavit (general court affidavit)
description: Sworn statement of facts filed under Order XIX CPC (and Supreme Court Rules where applicable). States facts only, never legal argument.

required_fields.name: court
required_fields.description: Court name exactly as in the main proceeding.

required_fields.name: case_number
required_fields.description: Case number exactly as in the main proceeding.

required_fields.name: parties
required_fields.description: Party array matching the main proceeding exactly.

required_fields.name: capacity
required_fields.description: Capacity in which the affidavit is sworn.

required_fields.name: averments
required_fields.description: Numbered paragraphs, each confined to a distinct portion of the subject, in chronological order, facts only.

required_fields.name: knowledge_source_per_para
required_fields.description: For each averment: whether from personal knowledge or information/belief, with the source (record/person) for the latter.

required_fields.name: purpose
required_fields.description: Relief supported or purpose for which the affidavit is sworn.

required_fields.name: verification_knowledge_paras
required_fields.description: Paragraph numbers true to the deponent's own knowledge.

required_fields.name: verification_belief_paras
required_fields.description: Paragraph numbers true to information and belief, with sources.

required_fields.name: attesting_authority
required_fields.description: Notary / Oath Commissioner / other authority competent to administer oaths, with seal and register number.

required_fields.name: annexures
required_fields.description: Documents referred to in the body: annexure and page numbers, paginated and attested.

boilerplate_structure.fixed_text: I, {deponent_name} S/D/W/o {deponent_relation}, aged {deponent_age}, {deponent_occupation}, residing at {deponent_address}, do hereby solemnly affirm and declare in the capacity of {capacity} as under.
Numbered paragraphs: {averments}. Each paragraph states its source: {knowledge_source_per_para}. Purpose: {purpose}.

I verify that paragraphs {verification_knowledge_paras} are true to my own knowledge and paragraphs {verification_belief_paras} are true to my information and belief (sources stated above), and nothing material is concealed. Verified at {verification_place_date}.
Sworn/affirmed before me by the deponent, identified to my satisfaction. {attesting_authority} (seal, date, register number). Annexures: {annexures}.

formatting_rules: Confine to facts the deponent can prove from personal knowledge (except interlocutory applications); state the source for information/belief.
Chronological sequence of dates and events; one distinct portion of the subject per paragraph.
Pages numbered consecutively; divided into numbered paragraphs; all numbers including dates in figures.
No mere reproduction of pleadings and no legal grounds/arguments — the court may strike such parts.
Annexed documents referenced with annexure and page numbers.
notes: Blanket verification of the whole affidavit as 'true to knowledge' when some paras are on information is a common ground for return.
Missing age/address, unmarked annexures, or attestation predating the facts deposed to are common defects.
